metadata.title: Cocktail Parade
metadata.notes: Pequeño folleto de cócteles publicado en plena Ley Seca tardía (marzo 1933). Las recetas están agrupadas por base alcohólica (gin, alcohol, Bacardi/ron, whisky, applejack) y muchas incluyen versiones no alcohólicas mediante el uso de siropes y zumos. Contiene rimas humorísticas intercaladas entre las recetas.

sections.title: Foreword
sections.content_original: Because we feel that so many of the present day cocktails are needlessly unpalatable and banal, special attention has been given to proportions and piquant combinations. We give recipes that have as the base, ingredients most neighborhoods have to offer. It is an effort to help the cocktail host or hostess serve a palatable drink of right proportions and materials usually on hand in the house. It is also hoped that there will be suggestions appealing to those having a knowledge of old time combinations, who have ceased mixing their favorite drink because some ingredient is unobtainable. In substituting syrups for cordials the general character of that particular cocktail has been preserved. By rubbing a quarter of a lemon around the edge of the glass, then dipping the glass in granulated sugar, an interesting and appealing way of serving dry cocktails is obtained. These recipes are balanced for either non-alcoholic or alcoholic base.
sections.content_es: Porque sentimos que muchos de los cócteles actuales resultan innecesariamente insípidos y banales, se ha prestado especial atención a las proporciones y a las combinaciones de sabor pronunciado. Ofrecemos recetas cuya base son ingredientes que casi cualquier barrio puede conseguir. Es un esfuerzo por ayudar al anfitrión o anfitriona a servir una bebida agradable, con las proporciones correctas y con materiales que normalmente se tienen en casa. También esperamos que haya sugerencias atractivas para quienes conocen las combinaciones clásicas y han dejado de preparar su bebida favorita porque algún ingrediente ya no se consigue. Al sustituir cordiales por siropes se ha preservado el carácter general de cada cóctel. Frotando un cuarto de limón en el borde del vaso y luego sumergiéndolo en azúcar granulada se obtiene una forma interesante y atractiva de servir cócteles secos. Estas recetas están equilibradas tanto para una base no alcohólica como alcohólica.

sections.title_es: Rimas finales e información del editor
sections.content_original: Mail address: Canapé Parade, Scarborough, N. Y. Publishers of CANAPÉ PARADE and COCKTAIL PARADE. Throughout the booklet appear short humorous rhymes between the recipes (e.g. 'My Brandy lies over the ocean...').
sections.content_es: Dirección postal: Canapé Parade, Scarborough, N. Y. Editores de CANAPÉ PARADE y COCKTAIL PARADE. A lo largo del folleto aparecen breves rimas humorísticas entre las recetas (p. ej. 'Mi Brandy está al otro lado del océano...').

recipes.raw_text: ALEXANDER. 2 portions Gin. 1 portion Creme de Cacao. 1 portion Cream.

ingredients.item_es: sirope espeso de albaricoque (del jugo de albaricoques en lata)

recipes.raw_text: APRICOT COCKTAIL. 2 parts Gin. 1 part heavy Apricot Syrup (from canned Apricots). Juice 1/2 lemon.
ALMOND EYES. 2 parts Gin. 1 part Maraschino syrup. Juice 1/2 lemon.
BEACH COMBER. 1 portion Gin. 1/2 portion Pineapple juice. 1/2 portion Lime juice.
BRONX. 2 parts Gin. 1 part French Vermouth. 1 part Italian Vermouth. Juice 1 orange.
BRONXVILLE. 2 parts Gin. 1 part Italian Vermouth. Juice 1 lime.

recipes.method_original: Combine ingredients; serve as a pick-me-up.
recipes.method_es: Combinar los ingredientes; servir como reanimante.
recipes.raw_text: CLAM JUICE PICK ME UP. 1 part Gin. 2 parts Clam-juice. Dash Worcestershire sauce.
COCK-ROBIN. 1 cocktail glass Gin. 1 tablespoon Rasp. Syrup. 1 egg white. Juice 1/2 lemon.
CLOVER CLUB. 2 parts Gin. 1 part Grenadine. White of 1 egg. Juice 1/2 lemon or 1 lime. Shake well. Serve pronto.
COMMUNIST. 2 parts Orange Juice. 2 parts Gin. 1 part Home-made Cherry Bounce. Juice 1/2 lemon.

ingredients.item_original: Grenadine or Heavy Raspberry or Strawberry Syrup
ingredients.item_es: granadina o sirope espeso de frambuesa o fresa

recipes.raw_text: CONTENTED COW (BLUE MOON). 1/3 Gin. 1/3 Rich Milk. 1/3 Grenadine or Heavy Rasp. or Strawberry Syrup.

ingredients.item_es: galletas de jengibre (o 1 porción de sirope de jengibre)

recipes.method_original: Break snaps into small pieces and frappé until they dissolve.
recipes.method_es: Romper las galletas en trozos pequeños y frapear hasta que se disuelvan.
recipes.raw_text: GINGER SNAP. 2 portions Gin. 10 Ginger Snaps (or 1 portion ginger syrup). Juice of 1/2 lemon. Break snaps into small pieces and frappe until they dissolve.

recipes.method_original: Filter through shaved ice in a tall glass, fill with ginger ale. A cooling summer drink.
recipes.method_es: Filtrar a través de hielo picado en un vaso alto y rellenar con ginger ale. Una bebida refrescante de verano.
recipes.raw_text: CONCORD MINUTE-MAN. 2 parts Grape-juice. 1 part Gin. Juice 1/2 lemon. Filter through shaved ice in a tall glass, fill with ginger ale. A cooling summer drink.

recipes.method_es: Combinar los ingredientes y agitar. 'No te pases con la apuesta.'
recipes.raw_text: GRAND SLAM. 1 portion Gin. 1 portion Applejack. 1 portion Orange juice. Juice 1/2 lemon. 1/2 portion Grenadine. Don't overbid.
HONEYLULU. 2 portions Gin. 1 portion Pineapple juice. 1/2 portion Honey (thin with hot water). Juice 1 lemon. White of 1 egg.

recipes.method_original: Stir into glass of shaved ice and fill with seltzer water.
recipes.method_es: Mezclar en un vaso con hielo picado y rellenar con agua de seltz.
recipes.raw_text: INFLATED SILVER. 1 portion Gin. 1/2 egg white. 1 teaspoon powdered sugar. Juice 1/2 lemon. Stir into glass of shaved ice and fill with seltzer water.

ingredients.item_es: huevos enteros, batidos a punto de nieve

ingredients.notes: porción igual a la mezcla, como base para un highball de ginger ale

recipes.method_original: Mix eggs and orange juice; use with an equal portion of Gin as a base for a ginger ale highball.
recipes.method_es: Mezclar los huevos con el zumo de naranja; usar con una cantidad igual de ginebra como base para un highball de ginger ale.
recipes.raw_text: JOHNNY BA-BAA. 1 pint Orange juice. 2 whole eggs beaten stiffly. Mix eggs and orange juice, use with an equal portion of Gin as a base for a ginger ale high-ball.
INFORMALITY. 1 part Lemon juice. 1 part Swedish Punch. 2 parts Gin.
JACK'S WELCOME. 2 parts Gin. 1 part Grapefruit juice (unsweetened). 1 part Honey (thin with hot water).
MARTINI. 1 part Italian Vermouth. 2 parts Gin. Juice 1/4 lemon.
IRISH MARTINI. 1 part French Vermouth. 2 parts Gin. 1/2 part Creme de Menthe. Juice 1/2 lemon.
MORNING BENEDICTION PICK ME UP. 1 part Orange juice. 2 parts Gin. White of 1 egg.
1933. Juice of whole Orange. 1 portion Gin. Shake with ice while dancing.

recipes.method_original: Frappé and serve with mint on top. A ladies' sweet drink for five o'clock.
recipes.method_es: Frapear y servir con menta encima. Una bebida dulce para señoras a las cinco de la tarde.
recipes.raw_text: POISON IVY. 1 part Cream. 1 part Creme de Menthe. 2 parts Gin. Frappe and serve with mint on top, A Ladies' sweet drink for five o'clock.

recipes.name_es: Dolor de Cabeza del Pobre (Sin Cura)
recipes.raw_text: POOR MAN'S HEAD-ACHE (No Cure). 1 part Gin. 1/2 part Orange juice. 1/2 part lemon juice. 2 teaspoons sugar.
ROSIE. 1 part Grenadine. 2 parts Gin. Juice 1 lime or 1/2 lemon.

recipes.method_original: Frappé well till all is dissolved. Serve at once, or we're absolved of a failure.
recipes.method_es: Frapear bien hasta que todo se disuelva. Servir de inmediato, o quedamos absueltos de un fracaso.
recipes.raw_text: STEP TO HEAVEN. 1/2 pint Gin. 1 pint Orange Ice. Juice 1 lemon. Frappe well till all's dissolved, Serve at once, or we're absolved Of a failure.

recipes.method_original: Filter through shaved ice in tall glass, fill with seltzer water. Cool in summer.
recipes.method_es: Filtrar a través de hielo picado en un vaso alto y rellenar con agua de seltz. Refrescante en verano.
recipes.raw_text: SOIXANTE-QUINZE. 1 portion Gin. 1/2 portion fresh Lime juice. 1 tablespoon powdered sugar. Filter thru shaved ice in tall glass, fill with seltzer water. Cool in summer.
TOMATO JUICE PICK ME UP. 1/2 part Tomato juice. 1 part Gin. Dash Worcestershire Sauce. Juice 1/4 lemon.

recipes.method_original: Shake and strain into tall glass. Add ice and split of soda water.
recipes.method_es: Agitar y colar en un vaso alto. Añadir hielo y un botellín de soda.
recipes.raw_text: TOM COLLINS. Juice 1/2 Lemon. 1/2 Tablespoonful powdered sugar. 1 Portion Gin. Shake and strain into tall glass, Add ice and split of soda water.

recipes.method_original: Use no ice. Shake thoroughly until mixed.
recipes.method_es: No usar hielo. Agitar bien hasta que se mezcle.
recipes.raw_text: WHITE ELEPHANT. 1/2 Vanilla Ice Cream. 1/2 Gin. Use no ice, shake thoroughly until mixed.

recipes.method_original: Shake well and serve at once.
recipes.method_es: Agitar bien y servir de inmediato.
recipes.raw_text: HARMON EXPRESS. 1 portion cold water. 1 portion Alcohol. 2 portions Orange juice. 1/2 portion lemon. White 1 egg. 1 tablespoon powdered sugar. Shake well and serve at once.

ingredients.item_original: Skin of oranges, cut in small pieces
ingredients.item_es: cáscara de naranja cortada en trozos pequeños

ingredients.item_original: Skin of lemons, cut in small pieces
ingredients.item_es: cáscara de limón cortada en trozos pequeños

recipes.method_original: Soak fruit in alcohol for one week, strain through sieve and use as a base for highballs.
recipes.method_es: Macerar las cáscaras en el alcohol durante una semana, colar por un tamiz y usar como base para highballs.
recipes.raw_text: TIGER SWEAT. Skin of 2 oranges cut in small pieces. Skin of 2 lemons cut in small pieces. 1 quart Alcohol. Soak fruit in alcohol for one week, strain thru sieve and use as a base for highballs.

recipes.method_original: Put a pickled onion in each glass. 'If that onion you can spear, the cocktail breath will disappear.'
recipes.method_es: Poner una cebolla en escabeche en cada copa. 'Si pinchas esa cebolla, el aliento a cóctel desaparecerá.'
recipes.raw_text: BOTTOMS UP. 1 part Bacardi. 1 part Homemade Wine (Sherry if possible). 1/4 part Lemon juice. Put a pickled onion in each glass.
BOOMERANG. 1 part Grenadine. 2 parts Bacardi. Juice 1/2 lemon. White 1 egg.
BACARDI SUNSET. 1 part Italian Vermouth. 2 parts Bacardi. Juice 1/2 lemon.
DEVIL WAGON. 1 part Bacardi. 1/2 part Grenadine. 1/2 part Apple-jack. Juice 1/4 lemon.
DAIQUIRI. 2 parts Bacardi. 1 part juice fresh limes. 1 tablespoon conf. sugar.
GOO-GOO EYES. 1 part Bacardi. 1 part Gin. 1 part Lemon juice. 1/2 part Maple Syrup.

recipes.method_original: Combine ingredients and shake. 'It can be done, it depends on your mouth.'
recipes.method_es: Combinar los ingredientes y agitar. 'Se puede lograr, depende de tu boca.'
recipes.raw_text: HOLE IN ONE. 1 part Bacardi. 1/2 part Lime Juice. 1/4 part Grenadine.
GRENADINE GUARDS. 1 part Bacardi. 1/2 part Grenadine. 1/4 part Lemon juice. 1/4 part Orange juice.
OVER-BOARD. 2 parts Bacardi. 1 part Gin. 1/2 part Vermouth (French). 1/2 part Lemon juice.
PLATONIC. 1 part Bacardi. 1/4 part Grenadine. 1/4 part Maraschino Syrup. Juice 1/2 lemon.

recipes.method_original: Combine ingredients and shake. Alternative formula: 1/3 Jamaica Rum, 1/3 Sweetening, 1/3 Sour (lemon or lime).
recipes.method_es: Combinar los ingredientes y agitar. Fórmula alternativa: 1/3 ron de Jamaica, 1/3 endulzante, 1/3 cítrico (limón o lima).
recipes.raw_text: PLANTERS PUNCH. 1 portion Jamaica Rum. 1/2 portion Grenadine. Juice 1/2 orange and 1/2 slice. Juice 1/2 lemon and 1/2 slice. Dash Angostura Bitters. Or: 1/3 Jamaica Rum, 1/3 Sweetening, 1/3 Sour (lemon or lime).
RUM RUNNER. 1 part Bacardi. 1/2 part Lime juice. 1/2 part Raspberry Syrup. 1/2 part Orange juice.

recipes.method_original: Build over ice with sugar and bitters; add whisky and vermouth; garnish with fruit and cherry.
recipes.method_es: Montar sobre hielo con el azúcar y el amargo; añadir el whisky y el vermut; decorar con la fruta y la cereza.
recipes.garnish: orange slice, lemon slice, maraschino cherry
recipes.raw_text: OLD FASHIONED. 1 lump sugar. 1 dash Angostura Bitters. 1 cube ice. 1 portion Whisky. 1/2 portion Italian Vermouth. 1 slice orange. 1 slice lemon. 1 Maraschino Cherry.
MANHATTAN. 1 part American Whisky. 1 part French Vermouth. 2 drops Angostura Bitters. Juice 1/4 orange.

recipes.method_original: Combine ingredients and shake. 'Something to hang onto when the night is wet.'
recipes.method_es: Combinar los ingredientes y agitar. 'Algo a lo que aferrarse cuando la noche está lluviosa.'
recipes.raw_text: LONDON LAMP-POST. 1 part Whisky. 1/2 Apple-jack or Brandy. 1/2 part Grenadine. Juice 1/2 Orange. Juice 1/2 Lemon. Something to hang onto when the night is wet.

ingredients.item_es: sirope de arce (diluir con agua caliente)

recipes.raw_text: 1—2—3. 1 part Lemon juice. 2 parts maple syrup (thin with hot water). 3 parts Rye.

recipes.method_original: Fill tall glass with ginger ale and cracked ice.
recipes.method_es: Rellenar el vaso alto con ginger ale y hielo picado.
recipes.raw_text: MAMIE TAYLOR. 1 hooker Whisky. Juice 2 Lemons. Fill tall glass with ginger ale and cracked ice.

ingredients.item_original: fresh mint stems crushed in water glass
ingredients.item_es: tallos de menta fresca machacados en un vaso de agua

recipes.method_original: Crush stems of fresh mint in water glass. Fill glass with shaved ice. Add one teaspoon sugar. Fill glass with Rye Whisky. Stir with spoon until glass is frosted.
recipes.method_es: Machacar tallos de menta fresca en un vaso de agua. Rellenar el vaso con hielo picado. Añadir una cucharadita de azúcar. Rellenar con whisky de centeno. Remover con cuchara hasta que el vaso se escarche.
recipes.raw_text: NECK AND NECK. Crush stems of fresh mint in water glass. Fill glass with shaved ice. Add one teaspoon sugar. Fill glass with Rye Whisky. Stir with spoon until glass is frosted.
POT POURRI. 2 parts Gin. 1 part Whisky. 1 part Italian Vermouth.

recipes.method_original: Combine ingredients and shake. 'Vote early and often.'
recipes.method_es: Combinar los ingredientes y agitar. 'Vota pronto y a menudo.'
recipes.raw_text: WARD EIGHT. 2 parts Rye. 1 part orange juice. 1 part lemon juice. 1/4 part Grenadine. Vote early and often.

ingredients.item_original: fresh lime juice or unsweetened grapefruit juice
ingredients.item_es: zumo de lima fresco o zumo de pomelo sin azúcar

recipes.method_original: Mix honey with apple-jack before placing in shaker.
recipes.method_es: Mezclar la miel con el applejack antes de poner en la coctelera.
recipes.raw_text: ABBOTT'S PRAYER No. 1. 1 1/2 parts Apple-jack. 1 part Honey. 1 part juice fresh limes or unsweetened grape-fruit juice. Mix honey with apple-jack before placing in shaker.

ingredients.item_es: zumo de limón (o zumo de pomelo)

recipes.method_original: Mix syrup with Apple-jack before placing in shaker.
recipes.method_es: Mezclar el sirope con el applejack antes de poner en la coctelera.
recipes.raw_text: ABBOTT'S PRAYER No. 2. 1 1/2 parts Apple-jack. 1 part Maple Syrup. 1 part lemon juice (or grape-fruit juice). Mix syrup with Apple-jack before placing in shaker.
DOCTOR DON. 2 parts Gin. 1 part Apple-jack. Juice 2 limes. 1/2 part Grenadine. White 1 egg.
FARMER'S FANCY. 1/3 Italian Vermouth. 2/3 Apple-jack. Dash Angostura Bitters.

recipes.method_original: Stir together in tall glass with cracked ice.
recipes.method_es: Remover juntos en un vaso alto con hielo picado.
recipes.raw_text: APPLE BLOSSOM. 1 portion Apple-jack. 8 oz. ice tea. Juice 1/2 lemon. 2 teaspoons brown sugar. Stir together in tall glass with cracked ice.

recipes.method_original: Fill large glass with cracked ice. Add teaspoon sugar. Add 1 dash Angostura Bitters. Add 1/2 cocktail glass Apple-jack. Put in tall glass with some lemon peel, filter cider through ice and serve.
recipes.method_es: Llenar un vaso grande con hielo picado. Añadir una cucharadita de azúcar. Añadir un golpe de Angostura. Añadir media copa de cóctel de applejack. Pasar a un vaso alto con un poco de piel de limón, filtrar la sidra a través del hielo y servir.
recipes.raw_text: HALLOWE'EN MISCHIEF. Fill large glass with cracked ice. Add teaspoon sugar. Add 1 dash Angostura Bitters. Add 1/2 cocktail glass Apple-jack. Put in tall glass with some lemon peel, filter cider thru ice and serve.
JACK ROSE. 1 part Apple-jack. 2 parts Gin. Juice 1 lime or 1/2 lemon. Tablespoon Grenadine.
JACK ROSE'S BROTHER. 1 part Grenadine. 2 parts Apple-jack. Juice 1 lime or 1/2 lemon.

recipes.method_original: Combine ingredients and shake. 'Draw two and have a full house.'
recipes.method_es: Combinar los ingredientes y agitar. 'Saca dos y tendrás un full.'
recipes.raw_text: THREE OF A KIND. 1 part Apple-jack. 1 part lime juice. 1 part Grenadine. Draw two— and have a full house.
TECHNOCRAT. 1 part Apple-jack. 1 part grape juice. Dash Angostura Bitters.
